description: This Java class 'LoginSteps' defines step definitions for Cucumber tests related to the login functionality of the OrangeHRM application. It includes various step implementations for navigating pages, entering credentials, verifying redirect behavior, error messages, and UI elements. The class uses Selenium WebDriver for browser interactions and leverages helper utilities and page objects to abstract common actions.

classes.name: LoginSteps
classes.description: Defines Cucumber step definitions for login-related scenarios in the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: theOrangeHRMApplicationIsAccessible
methods.description: Navigates to the base URL and verifies the application is accessible.

methods.name: theDatabaseIsInAKnownCleanState
methods.description: Precondition step assuming the database is clean, managed externally.

methods.name: theUserIsOnTheLoginPage
methods.description: Navigates to a specified login page path.

methods.name: theAdminUserIsLoggedIn
methods.description: Logs in as the admin user via helper method.

methods.name: anESSUserIsLoggedIn
methods.description: Logs in as an ESS user via helper method.

methods.name: aUserAccountExistsThatHasBeenDisabled
methods.description: Precondition assuming a disabled user exists in test data.

methods.name: anEmployeeHasBeenTerminatedButTheUserAccountStillExists
methods.description: Precondition assuming a terminated employee's account still exists.

methods.name: theUserIsOnThePage
methods.description: Navigates to a specific page URL.

methods.name: noUserIsLoggedIn
methods.description: Clears cookies/session to ensure no user is logged in.

methods.name: theUserEntersUsernameAndPassword
methods.description: Enters provided username and password into login form fields.

methods.name: theUserClicksTheButton
methods.description: Clicks a button identified by its displayed text.

methods.name: theUserClicksTheButtonWithoutEnteringCredentials
methods.description: Clicks a button without filling credentials.

methods.name: theUserEntersValidCredentialsAndSubmitsTheForm
methods.description: Logs in using valid credentials and submits the form.

methods.name: theDisabledUserAttemptsToLogInWithValidCredentials
methods.description: Attempts login with a disabled user's credentials.

methods.name: theTerminatedEmployeeAttemptsToLogIn
methods.description: Attempts login as a terminated employee.

methods.name: theSessionTimesOut
methods.description: Simulates session timeout by clearing session cookies.

methods.name: theUserIsRedirectedToTheLoginPage
methods.description: Navigates to a login page intended to trigger redirect.

methods.name: theUserLogsInAgainWithValidCredentials
methods.description: Re-logs in with valid credentials.

methods.name: theUserNavigatesToTheLoginPage
methods.description: Navigates to a specified login page.

methods.name: theUserAttemptsToNavigateDirectlyTo
methods.description: Attempts to navigate directly to a specific URL.

methods.name: theUserShouldBeRedirectedToTheDashboard
methods.description: Verifies redirection to dashboard URL.

methods.name: theFieldShouldDisplayValidationError
methods.description: Checks that a form field displays a specific validation error.

methods.name: theLoginPageShouldDisplayAnErrorMessage
methods.description: Verifies an error message appears on login page.

methods.name: theLoginPageShouldDisplayAnErrorMessage
methods.description: Checks for presence of error or validation messages.

methods.name: theUserShouldRemainOnTheLoginPage
methods.description: Ensures user remains on login page.

methods.name: thePOSTToShouldReturnARedirectResponse
methods.description: Verifies redirect response after a POST (by URL change).

methods.name: theLoginLogoImageShouldBeVisible
methods.description: Verifies login page logo visibility.

methods.name: theLoginBannerImageShouldBeVisible
methods.description: Verifies banner image visibility on login page.

methods.name: theSocialMediaSectionShouldBeDisplayedAsConfigured
methods.description: Checks social media section presence.

methods.name: theLoginFormShouldContainAHiddenCSRFTokenField
methods.description: Checks for presence of CSRF token hidden input.

methods.name: theCSRFTokenShouldBeIncludedInThePOSTRequestTo
methods.description: Verifies CSRF token inclusion via successful login.

methods.name: theUserShouldBeRedirectedToTheHomePageViaHomePageService
methods.description: Verifies redirection to the home page after login.

methods.name: noScriptExecutionShouldOccur
methods.description: Checks for prevention of XSS script execution.

methods.name: theUserShouldBeRedirectedBackTo
methods.description: Verifies redirect back to a specific URL.

methods.name: theUserLogsInAgainWithUsernameAndPassword
methods.description: Re-logs in with specified credentials.
